title: Shared tangent basis with private nonlinear residual allocation
hypothesis: A shared rank-4 tangent basis plus the smallest support-derived private residual rank will preserve nonlinear heldout quality at >=25% fewer complete bytes than independent updates, and its byte/quality frontier will beat native PCA-plus-residual and VeRA-style scaling controls.

world.split: six ordinary tasks fit shared basis; two ordinary and two private-exception tasks held out; last two receive private directions

development.tuning: none; closed-form tangent least squares; private residual ranks 0,1,2,4

fresh.release_rule: Keep fresh sealed after native factorization alias or quality/byte gate miss.

controls: exact nonlinear teacher update upper bound
VeRA-style fixed random basis with learned per-task scaling
success_gate: At a predeclared scale, at least one residual rank must attain nRMSE <=0.02, save >=25% complete bytes vs independent updates, improve on shared-only, and strictly beat native PCA/VeRA controls.
failure_gate: FAIL if no residual rank meets quality and byte gates, or the best Mirror frontier aliases a native factorization/simple control.
boundaries: Synthetic tanh MLP only; no pretrained/LLM or real PEFT claim.
Two exception tasks are constructed with private directions; the screen tests boundary localization, not a natural frequency estimate.
Private residuals are fitted from support and fully charged.
Fresh seeds remain sealed after alias or gate miss.
